file_stem: RWB TE 002 Code owners for the recovery module
title: Code owners for the recovery module
goal: A CODEOWNERS file plus a branch rule make sure every recovery or common change is approved by its owning team
why: The recovery module lives in the shared ACE repository. Migrations and common code must be reviewed by the team that owns them.
triggers: ACE admin sets the branch rule on main
ace_note: No ACE read. It protects the migration folder db/migration/recovery/, owned by the TechX recovery tech leads.
stores: .github/CODEOWNERS; GitHub branch rule on main; pipeline

functions.name: CODEOWNERS
functions.does: path -> owning team, last match wins

functions.name: CodeOwnersValidation
functions.does: fails on missing owner or pattern

rules: BR1: recovery back end, test and migration paths -> @scb-ace/techx-recovery-tech-leads
BR5: the last matching pattern wins
BR6: author approval does not count; a new commit dismisses approvals
risks: Approval from a non-owner -> blocked ('Review required from code owners')
Owner team not found -> validation fails ('owner {team} not found')
example: PR touches recovery/casewf/internal/AllocationService.java and a common/ file
